note: Budget architecture contract (D-039). No values: real figures enter only as observations (data/normalized/observations/apbn_*.jsonl) and are turned into the game baseline by scripts/pipelines/calibration/build_budget.py. Official classification names are CANDIDATES to verify against APBN 2026 documents before use.

layers.REAL: observations apbn_*/apbd_* (Kemenkeu, DJPK) — none ingested yet
layers.GAME_BASELINE: game/data/budget.json — pool_rp (null until REAL), sector base shares (neutral, UNCALIBRATED), level bounds
layers.SIMULATED: SimWorld.national — budget_level, budget_shares, fiscal_space; SimWorld.policy_state — commitments; Simulation.fiscal_report() — monthly ledger in FU

unit.FU: Fiscal Unit: 100 FU = one year of the baseline program envelope. When pool_rp is REAL, rupiah = FU x pool_rp / 100 (display only; equations unchanged).

accounts.game_role: simulated as index: baseline revenue = 100 FU/yr (covers baseline program envelope)
accounts.official_classification: candidate: Pendapatan Negara dan Hibah (perpajakan, PNBP, hibah)
